id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

status.description: The status of processing a request.

result.description:
A generic string field that can hold information regarding the request's processing.
The lambda can set this field to arbitrary values.
Could be serialized data structures, or just a basic message.

error.description:
A generic string field that can hold information regarding the request's processing.
The lambda can set this field to arbitrary values.
Could be serialized data structures, or just a basic message.

topic.description:
For structured requests, requests which have a defined structure and additional fields beyond those on
{@link C3RequestFields}, this is the name of a {@link Type}.
For unstructured requests, this is a human readable name for a particular type of request.

In both cases, this field is used to find the {@link C3Request.Processor} that is in charge of processing the
approval or denial of this request.

data.description:
Data used by the {@link C3Request.Processor} to perform it's processing.
More complex structures of data can done by creating a subtype of {@link C3Request} or as
json serialized data in this field.

state.description:
The current state of this request.
The state changes upon approval or denial and when processing has completed.

received.description: The timestamp when this request was received.

requestedBy.description:
The {@link User} who made the request. This generally will be the human user
who made the request.

requesterComment.description: Comment left by the user who is requesting.

decided.description: The timestamp when this request was approved or denied.

decidedBy.description:
The user who approved or denied the request. This generally will to be the human user
who made the decision.

deciderComment.description: Comment left by the user who decided the request (either by approve, cancel, or deny).

deciderData.description:
Data associated with the decision.
{@link C3Request.DeciderSpec#data}

processed.description:
Whether or not this request has been fully processed.
If true, the outcome of the requests {@link C3Request.Processor} is guarenteed to have been applied.

processStart.description:
The timestamp when the async action for processing this request was started. Can be used alongside
{@link #processEnd} to determine how long processing took.
This does not include the time it took for the request to be decided upon, or the time it took the async
processor to pick up this action. This only includes the time at which the async processor began
processing this request.

processEnd.description:
The timestamp when the async action for processing this request was finished. Can be used alongside
{@link #processStart} to determine how long processing took.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

actionQueueEntryObjId.description:
A transient id describing the most recent {@link ActionQueue} entry attempting to process this request.
This field can be inaccurate at any point in time. Request processors must be idempotent, and it is possible
for two or more {@link ActionQueue} entries to exist at the same time for any request.

processSubmitted.description:
The timestamp at which the most recent {@link ActionQueue} entry attempting to process this request was submitted.
This field can be inaccurate at any point in time. Request processors must be idempotent, and it is possible
for two or more {@link ActionQueue} entries to exist at the same time for any request.

title:
Provides a base class for request entities.
{@link C3Request#state} has an expected linear progression:
- Creation: PENDING
- Decision: PENDING -> APPROVING | PENDING -> DENYING | PENDING -> CANCELLING
- Processing: APPROVING -> APPROVED | DENYING -> DENIED | CANCELLING -> CANCELLED
name: C3Request
